retrieval_policy.current_job_result: No external course pages, repositories, recordings, notes, or lab files were fetched.
future_retrieval_preconditions: the later job explicitly authorizes external retrieval
the candidate URL is public and its source identity is verified
access does not require credentials, enrollment, payment, circumvention, or guessing hidden locations
license and learner-view permissions are recorded before publication
future_ingestion_requirements: capture the canonical URL, retrieval timestamp, content hash, media type, and source revision when applicable
scan the material for secrets, hidden graders, sealed references, solutions, and other learner-owned files
classify each artifact as official unit, supplemental resource, catalog pointer, or unavailable description
keep source inputs read-only and copy permitted content only into a per-attempt workspace
record validation labels before any material becomes learner-visible
retrieval_policy.promotion_rule: LINK_ONLY_NOT_RETRIEVED and DESCRIBED_ONLY_UNAVAILABLE records cannot be promoted to AVAILABLE or to official units without captured content and deterministic classification evidence.
retrieval_policy.restricted_content_rule: Do not retrieve, copy, expose, or reconstruct gated content, credentials, solutions, hidden graders, sealed references, or another learner's files.
retrieval_policy.fallback_rule: If a resource remains unavailable, preserve the blocked record and build only clearly labeled manager-authored material that does not impersonate the source course.
